text: Fenjor Foxbite is a Nord residing in the town of Dragonstar.

Feluz is a Khajiit moon-sugar addict. On his way to the Baandari Trading Post with his wife Liane, he wandered off the beaten path into the jungle while under the influence of the drug. After he is found, he can be seen resting at the Silver Moons Inn.
Feran Relenim is a Dunmer guild trader. He operates his kiosk, The Trade Pen, on the road between Narsis and Muth Gnaar.
Fenus Marethi is a Dunmer hunter of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found in Fort Amol.
Fenderil is an Altmer commoner residing in the city of Sentinel.
Farrokh at-Hassef is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.

Ferhad is a Redguard found in his home with Dariah, his wife, in the city of Sentinel. He does not appear until the Vestige talks to Unishi during the related quest, and he disappears along with Dariah after they deliver both potions.
Farvour Eriel is a Breton found at the Dusklight Inn in the town of Hoarfrost Downs in Rivenspire.
Farmorion is an Altmer clothier and member of the Fighters Guild found selling his wares at the Earth Forge.
Farseer Bodani is a Dunmer Ashlander and the leader of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found in their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.

Farseer Tirinaat is a Dunmer Ashlander and the wisewoman of the Kagesh Tribe currently found near Iliath Temple. She acts as the emissary between her tribe and the priests in the wake of the warchief's, Ashkhan Ziddak Dunhaki, unsanctioned attack.
Farvild Drakesbane is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Shor's Stone.
Fatahala is a Dark Seducer in posing as an Altmer found at The Manor of Revelry in Coldharbour.
Father Quiston is a Breton priest found at the Pelin Graveyard.
Faulbor is a Bosmer bard performing at the Trader's Rest in Velyn Harbor. He is currently working a ballad about freeing of the harbor.
Faurinar is a Bosmer drunkard, and patron of the Market-Side Meadery in Skywatch.
Fausta Arius is an Imperial soldier of the Legion of the West Weald. She is found at their camp at Senalana.
Favas Rathri is a Dunmer residing inside Captain Viveka's house found in Riften.
Fazaddu is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. He resides inside his house at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Fealu Aravel is a Dunmer fisherwoman residing in Davon's Watch, Stonefalls.
Federic is a Breton who died in the Bloodfiend attack on Moira's Hope.
Federic Seychelle is a Breton found outside Edrald Estate in Rivenspire, High Rock. He is also the lover of Arlie Edrald, the daughter of the owners of the Edrald Estate.
Feladir is a Bosmer working at the Hearty Hoarvor at the Redfur Trading Post.
Felari is a Khajiit moon priestess trying ease the relations between her kind and the Wood Elves by retrieving ancient relics related to their history in ancient battle sites.
Feldsii Maren is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is part of the contingent that was sent to investigate the Sathram Plantation.
Felra is a hostile Redguard and member of the Order of the Black Worm found in Stillrise Village in Shadowfen.
Felrar is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is the magister of their branch in Nimalten.
Feluni is a Khajiit and the owner of the Thizzrini Arena. She is also the one who arranges the combats and tournaments.
Felycie Canis is a member of the Daggerfall Covenant found at the Southern High Rock Gate.
Fendros Faryon is a Dunmer guild trader. He operates his kiosk at The Marbruk Mart in Marbruk.
Fenila Redoran is a Dunmer priestess of House Redoran. She is found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Fennus Thirano is a Dunmer banker working at the Uveran Bank in Davon's Watch.
Fenorfar is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact and patron of Deldwine's Inn at Fort Amol.
Ferocious Jakidi is a Nord member of the Undaunted. She is found with her fellow companions at The Withered Tree in Nimalten.
Ferva Hloril is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in the Hollow City.
Faulor is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild trapped inside Spindleclutch I, Glenumbra, in .
Father Egnatius is a priest in the Imperial City. He is noted by Mannimarco to be unbreakable to their will, and that his shadow "looms over every proceeding" of the Elder Council.
Favis is a Redguard in . He frequently argues with Prnell about his duties in the Bell Tower.
Fenn is a welwa residing in the Valley of Scars in Craglorn.

Felgol is a deceased Breton and member of the Undaunted, part of the destroyed group found in the Hall of the Warrior in Hel Ra Citadel, found also alongside Ludippe Guegan. He is the author of Felgol's Note.
Felsa Ramori is a Dunmer residing inside Nalman's house in Stormhold.
Ferlulril is an Altmer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Fermadnar is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Fedar Githrano is a Dunmer found on the roads of Wrothgar. He is seeking a beast-master named Nikolvara who is rumored to possess a whistle strong enough to tame wild durzogs.
Farmir is an Altmer found with his wife Haghai at their camp in The Rift, at one of their possible locations. The Vestige can light their fire as part of the Lightbringer achievement.
Fealote is a Bosmer commoner and member of the Falinesti Faithful. He is found at their camp located at the Falinesti Autumn Site in Reaper's March.
Felipe Rarnis is a Breton residing in the Baandari Trading Post.
Farvyn Rethan is a Dunmer guild trader. He operates out of his kiosk, Dockside Oddments, in Abah's Landing.
Felisa Thirvayn is a Dunmer patron of the Loose Tooth Lodge in the Stonetooth Fortress.
Feril Relvani is a Dunmer priest found in Iliath Temple. He has no unique dialogue.
Farul is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk, Farul's Fine Wares, at the Trader's Circle in Kvatch.
Faylva is a Nord residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell. She cannot be interacted with.
Felayn Uvaram is a Dunmer guild trader found at the Mushroom Tower Market in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell.
Farwen Temolire is an Altmer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is located inside the Gnisis Mine Barracks.
Farseer Kuamta is a Dunmer Ashlander located in Ald'ruhn on Vvardenfell. She is participating in the celebrations of Skar's death and undertakes a trial of becoming Wise Woman.
Fenton was a Bosmer that served in Captain Ione's company during the Oblivion Crisis.

Fawelayne is an Altmer noble residing in the Bosmer town of Bramblebreach in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood. She spends most of her time relaxing behind some huts in the southmost corner of the little settlement.
Farvour Esmery is a Breton member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Farvour Esmery is an Altmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Felamusa is a Khajiit servant residing in the Cloisters in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. She does not have any unique dialogue.
Faustina Curio is a Imperial Achievement Mediator who can be found in either Elden Root, Wayrest, or Mournhold, depending on the Vestige's alliance.
Felvos Nithryon is a Dunmer laborer found at the southern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Fenewen is an Altmer fisher found at the southern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Farniri is a Khajiit laborer found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.

Felarian is an Altmer in who resides in Alinor providing Jewelry Crafting Certification. He can be found under a tree to the left when facing the entrance to the Plaza of the Hand from the bridge crossing the river.
Farwunte is an Altmer who can be found in the poaceae fields southwest from Ceporah Tower in Artaeum.
Farmolbrian is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Ferrus Mallon is a Imperial found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He is leader of the Jovial Lambasters.
Fennorian, also known as Fenn, is an Altmer vampire encountered in various locations depending on the Vestige's choices.
Farsh is a Redguard residing in The Lonely Troll in Solitude.
Fegra is a Hag that is being worshiped by Grey Viper Defilers at Vlastarus Towers in Cyrodiil.
Faryan is a character located in Hircine's Haunt, Craglorn, in . She is one of the aspects of the Celestial Mage.
Findulain is a Bosmer found in the Shulk Egg Mine. He is seen during the "Egg Poachers" quest.
Ferynu Indrano is a Dunmer living in the Redoran Stronghold of Marandus. She is also a member of House Redoran.
Fiiriel is an Altmer Barbarian living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Fighters Guild. He is found inside the East Empire North Warehouse with Haening.
Fetid Jofnhild is a Nord beggar who lives in Bruma. His bedroll can be found west of Bruma's north gate.
Fianna is a Breton maid in Whiterun who performs menial chores around Dragonsreach. She seems to hold the Jarl, Balgruuf the Greater, in high esteem.
Filnjar is a Nord blacksmith who resides at his house in the town of Shor's Stone, which he appears to be the unofficial community leader of.
Fevasa Saryon is a Dunmer herder who resides on the Gro-Bagrat Plantation.
Fevris Senoril is a Dunmer mage. He can be found inside Ramimilk and is hostile.
Fevus Aryon is a Dunmer bard, and resides in the stronghold of Rotheran. More specifically, he is located within the arena room of the stronghold.
Fevyn Ralen is a Dunmer mage residing in the Waistworks of the Telvanni Canton. Fevyn is a short-tempered mage who has little time for those who will not engage in business with him.
Fieryra is a Dunmer witch who resides outside of Ald Daedroth, a Daedric Shrine. She is often near the water's edge.
Finna was a Nord who lived during the late Merethic Era. Finna was instrumental to the Nord's victory during the last battle against the the Snow Elves as she killed their commander.
Fillin is a Bosmer barbarian and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the top level of the stronghold's keep.

Fethis Alor is a Dunmer merchant living in Raven Rock. He can be found next to his market stall, where he sells wares. He is usually seen wearing a traditional Dunmer outfit and shoes and carries the key to his house.
Fetches-Glitter is an Argonian merchant in who resides in Davon's Watch, Stonefalls, working at his stall, Dhalmora Fine Goods. He can also be found at a stall Patience Breeds Wealth in Dhalmora.

Finoriell is a Bosmer located in Mistral. The current "Green Lady," her real name is later revealed as Finoriell by her niece, Gwaering. Her niece is her successor. The Green Lady died while traveling on behalf of the Aldmeri Dominion. Finoriell died while on the shores of Pyandonea. She sought revenge against the Maormer after the death of her dear Silvenar, but fell while fighting them. Her soul went to rest at Treehenge, a sacred grove where all Green Lady's souls go after death.
Fiesque Justal is a Breton found in the Daggerfall Millworks in Daggerfall. She and the alchemist Ramina al-Morwha have set up their Alchemy Station inside the mill.

Fildgor Orcthane, once known as Fildgor Strong-Prince or Fildgor Angry Prince, is a Nord prince born to Queen Mabjaarn Flame-Hair of Skyrim. He is Jorunn the Skald-King's exiled brother and leader of the famed Stormfist Brigade of western Skyrim. The Vestige encounters Fildgor with his Stormfist and Orsimer allies throughout Eastmarch as they try to usurp the throne from the current High King. He takes on the name Fildgor Orcthane and tries to disrupt the festivities of the Konunleikar in Windhelm, and is considered the region's primary antagonist.
Findredil is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Filenarth is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. She can be found in the Altmer Embassy.
Firaldaale is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Fingrathel is a Bosmer beggar who can be found in The Middens in Elden Root.

Firas is a Redguard merchant residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. He owns and operates a wagon in the Town Square, Firas First Shop. When first engaged in dialogue, he refers to Dame Dabienne, a criminal who has been put in the stocks to be humiliated.
Finvir is a Bosmer found in the Bad Man's Hallows, Glenumbra, in .
Finds-Plants is an Argonian brewer residing in the region of Bal Foyen.
Filedh is a Bosmer residing in the city of Marbruk. She spends most of her time dancing to the lute played by Elderien.
Filberel is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, Greenshade.
Fethesena Nerendas is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Hallin's Stand.
Fire-Under-His-Tongue is an Argonian residing outside the Instruction Halls in Shad Astula.
Fights-With-Tail is an Argonian residing in the city of Elinhir.
Fintholor the Brewmaster is a Bosmer brewer residing in the city of Windhelm.
Ferzend al-Sentinel is a Redguard found on the Sentinel Docks.
Ferzhela is a Redguard guild trader selling her wares at the Skystep Stalls in Skywatch.
Feyne Vildan is a Dunmer found at the Percolating Mire. She is married to the Argonian Ja-Reet.
Fheg is an Orsimer warrior residing in the city of Belkarth, Craglorn. He works as a guard in the Belkarth Banking House.
Fiabess is a Bosmer patron of the Outside Inn in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Fijirra is a Khajiit who resides in the town of Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
Filingaer is a Bosmer working at Nimare's Noble Steeds in Marbruk.
Fills-Up-On-Fish is an Argonian residing at his hut in the town of Xal Ithix, Shadowfen.
Filoneth is a Bosmer sailor who has been kidnapped by the pirates established at the Crimson Cove.

Filpormo is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Haven, where he is in charge of teaching the new pupils. He can be found on the second floor, overlooking the mages below from a balcony.
Fimaz-ra is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. He is the armsman of their branch in Velyn Harbor.
Fimius Barbula is an Imperial armsman and a member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at the Earth Forge.
Fimius Caepo is an Imperial found at the Redfur Trading Post.
Fimrimion is an Altmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is part of the Aldmeri invasion force at the Hatching Pools in Shadowfen.
Finedrin is a Bosmer found in Rawl'kha. He is in the stocks for various crimes.
Fingaenion is a Bosmer who is one of the few survivors of the Daedra attack on Whisper Grove.
Finia Marcott is a Breton merchant and part of the group of outlaws found beneath Shornhelm, in a refuge. Finia has been accused of treason, and so was exiled from her home.
Finlas is a Bosmer found in the outskirts of Rawl'kha. He has no unique dialogue.
Firagaer is a Bosmer leatherworker selling his wares at his stall, Bone-Awl Outfitters, in Mistral.
Fighters Guild Sentry is a generic Fighters Guild NPC who can be found throughout Tamriel. They normally appear in Fighters Guild quests or associated guildhalls.
Fethis Drarara is a Dunmer found inside the Velmont Mansion in Abah's Landing.
Firanarth is a Bosmer in who can be found in Deepwoods, Malabal Tor.
Filbolrel is a Bosmer who can be found living in his house with Nitholeth in Deepwoods, Malabal Tor.
Finnorieth is a Bosmer Artisan residing in Borwiian's House, Vulkwasten in . The only way to interact with her is by breaking into the locked Borwiian's House.
Fevila Vavas is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Filthwhisker is a Khajiit beggar encountered at various locations across The Rift.
Findun is a Bosmer merchant working at Findun's Goods in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell.
Fexxel is one of the chefs that work in Umbriel. He is a character who appears in .
Fhena was an Umbrielian with the appearance of a Dunmer. She became Mere-Glim's lover and played a vital role in the Umbriel Crisis.

Finyedalin is an Altmer noble reading in a courtyard beneath the Monastery of Serene Harmony in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. When approached, she complains about the noise coming from the nearby Dockworks.

Festival Merrymaker is a generic character found in major alliance cities around jesters and near the Jester's Festival Tents during the Jester's Festival. They are dressed in festive costumes. They cannot be interacted with.
Fighters Guild Bodyguard is a generic member of the Fighters Guild defending the Queen Arzhela in Nchu Duabthar Threshold. They cannot be interacted with.
Fif Byrp't is a camel found by the stables in Hakoshae, Northern Elsweyr.
Finious Sorick is a Breton working at one of the stables at Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil in .
Fhozt is a Redguard guard in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Fezzam is a Khajiit located in Southern Elsweyr at random encounters in . He is found with Balga and Trezzi listening to the stories of Moon-Singer Feziya-ko.
Fildenir is a character located in the Bone Orchard, Grahtwood, in .
Filer Pix is a creature that appears in . It will ask the Vestige to help out in the Infinite Archive.
Filer Myx is a creature that appears in , in the Infinite Archive.
Flacassia Fauseius is an Imperial located in the Foreign Quarter Plaza and a member of the Mages Guild. She is the Guild Guide for Vivec City.
Flaenia Amiulusus is an Imperial drillmaster. She is a Journeyman with the Fighters Guild in Balmora.
Fjorrod is a Nord commoner in Dagon Fel, Morrowind. He can be found in his shack.
Fjol is a Nord barbarian who resides in the Bitter Coast region. He survives on his earnings as a bandit, and robs travelers on the roads near Hla Oad.
Fjori the Stout is a Nord slaver who resides in Minabi, Morrowind.
Firir is a deceased adventurer in that can be found in Chillwind Depths. He was investigating an assault on a merchant caravan near Dragon Bridge.
Fjori was a huntress in the forests of Skyrim before the dragons returned.

Fjola is a Nord bandit leader encountered in Mistwatch. She left her husband, Christer, and returned to Skyrim. Upon returning, she became the leader of the bandits who had taken over the abandoned fort of Mistwatch on the southern border of Eastmarch.
Firneril is an Altmer residing in Port Hunding, in Headman Bhosek's palace. She is being seduced by Jakarn.
First Mate Mathad is a Khajiit sailor and the second-in-command of The Prowler.
Firthaedal is a Bosmer residing in Woodhearth, in the region of Greenshade. He can be found by the docks.

First Mate Elvira Derre is a Breton residing in Steelheart Moorings, Stormhaven. She is the second-in-command of Captain Albert Marck. She asks for help rescuing her companions taken hostage by the Ember-Eye Slavers who use the settlement as a base. She will approach the Vestige when located near the town.
Fistalle is an Altmer member of the Eyes of the Queen in who met her end in Mathiisen. She was hired and trained personally by Razum-dar.
Fjrokvar is a Nord barbarian and member of the false Skaal tribe on Solstheim. He can be found inside the Raven Rock Mine.
Fishcatcher is a Khajiit chef. She works at The Boatman's Tail in Mistral, on the Island of Khenarthi's Roost.

First Mate Liennas is a Bosmer located in Eagle's Strand. When she is first encountered, she expresses disappointment in her orders from Commander Karinith, who asks her to remain where she is. Instead, she would much rather be searching for, and rescuing, her crew.
Firtirantar is an Altmer found in Ezduiin, an ancient Ayleid Ruin. He cannot be interacted with directly.
Fishmonger Kazra is a Khajiit grocer in who sells her wares at her shop in Skywatch.
Fjar Moonstrike is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed at Fort Amol.
Firras is Bosmer and a former member of the Stormwardens. He defected the order and joined the invading Sea Vipers, granting them access to the ruins of Ilayas and the Sphere of Storms.
First Mate Jalan is a Khajiit located in Coldharbour's Lost Fleet in . He is the second-in-command of Captain One-Eye's crew, and is accompanying her on her journey into Coldharbour.
First Mate Valion is the first mate under Captain Seritenya.
Firtoril is an Altmer in who bets on the frog races in Skywatch in hoping to relieve the debt she acquired racing frogs.
Fishbreath is a Khajiit and the leader of the Dawnmead Bandits. He is found in the ruins of Claw's Strike alongside his pet lion, Lord Tawnlii-do.
Fistamanwe is an Altmer Mage, and member of the Mages Guild part of the excavation team found in the ruins of Ezduiin.
Five-Coins is the Argonan innkeeper and proprietor of the Coin Brothers' Cornerclub in the city of Stormhold, Shadowfen. He is the brother of Six-Coins.
Fjar is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact who has been captured by the Lion Guard hidden in The Lion's Den.
Fjorna Lastblood is a Nord ghost found south of Jorunn's Stand.
Flavia Scaeva is an Imperial residing inside her house in Cropsford.
Firiliril is a Bosmer found welcoming travelers to Willowgrove just outside the town's entrance.
Flavia Russus is an Imperial found in Anvil, The Gold Coast. She can be seen at the docks, near the Laeranir's House, sometimes talking to Lepida Melitus. She cannot be interacted with.
Firstmage Arnure is an Altmer mage found inside the Aetherian Archive.
Fisinwe is an Altmer alchemist residing in Phaer. She is pretending to be one of the many who fell victim to the plague afflicting the town, but is not actually sick.
Flanneth is a Bosmer and one of the last members of the Driladan Clan. She is found in the Shadows Crawl.
First Mate Rodros is a Maormer pirate and the second-in-command of the Wake Walkers, a gang encountered inside Shark's Teeth Grotto, where they are looking for a supposedly legendary treasure.
Fjokki the Bard is a mentioned-only famous Nord warrior-poet. Rigurt the Brash compared poetry of the warrior-poet Vivec with Fjokki's poetry and found it is "not at all as interesting or bawdy."
Firlarmil is an Altmer servant working at the Anchors Aweigh Inn in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Flaniethe is a Bosmer residing in the garden of Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene during the quest "The Queen's Decree." She has no unique dialogue.
Firtarcil is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Fleshrender is a Harpy boss that appears in . She can be found along with Orzik the Storm-Born and Talonclaw in the southern interior of Old Orsinium.
Flakk the Hungerer is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.
First Mate Drigsen is a Redguard in and a member of The Silver Cormorant in Western Skyrim.
Fleet Queen Taleria is a Maormer located in Dreadsail Reef, High Isle and Amenos, in .
Flame-Bearer is a Redguard located at Rahni'Za, School of Warriors, Craglorn, in .
Flame-Herald Bahsei is an Argonian residing in Rockgrove. She is the second boss fought in that location.
Firstmage Anirwen is an Altmer located in the Aetherian Archive, Craglorn, in .
Firstmage Earil is an Altmer located in the Aetherian Archive, Craglorn, in .

Folms Mirel is a Dunmer enchanter, and the senior member of the Caldera Mages Guild. He is one of the people with whom the Nerevarine can speak to join the Mages Guild. Folms can enchant items, and also offers a range of items for sale to guild members ranked Conjurer or higher.
Foronir is a Bosmer living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni, and guards Trerayna Dalen.
Folsi Thendas is a Dunmer caravaner who runs the Silt Strider service in Suran.
Fonas Retheran is a Dunmer living in the Ghostgate. She is a member of House Redoran.

Foroch is a Bosmer and the proprietor of the Gottshaw Inn, in the far west of Cyrodiil and along the Gold Road. Foroch rents rooms for 10 each and sells alcohol and food. He is an Apprentice Mercantile trainer.
Floyd Nathans is a Breton residing in his home and is one of three living in the settlement of Blankenmarch. Many of the villagers are quiet including himself throughout the village.
Folvalie Omalor is a Dunmer agent and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. She can be found on the upper level and is hostile.
Folvys Andalor is a Dunmer who resides in Ald'ruhn. He can be found in the Ald'ruhn Temple.
Fonus Rathryon is a Dunmer pilgrim who can be found in the Ashlands of Morrowind at the co-ordinates (-5,12). He will ask for a guide to Koal Cave.
Florentius Baenius is an Imperial priest of Arkay. He also serves as a master-level trainer in Restoration and an apothecary merchant to members of the Dawnguard.
Fons Beren is a Dunmer noble who resides in the Great Bazaar in Mournhold. He claims to be a ladies' man and will ask the Nerevarine if they know any women that are single.
Forge-Wife Glesh is an Orsimer member of the Seamount Clan in Stonetooth Smithy, and is one of Chief Tazgol's wives. Heart-Wife Sholg is another one of his wives.
Fordan is a Bosmer soldier residing in Eagle's Strand in the region of Khenarthi's Roost. He is found lying wounded on a bed in the makeshift hospital at Eagle's Strand.
Forgotten Seneschal is a deceased Breton residing in at the Tomb of Lost Kings, Glenumbra, in . He has been bound for eternity within the tomb and asks the Vestige for help freeing his soul.
Fongoth is a Bosmer found at the Rootwater Grove, Greenshade. He is a member of the Wooded Eye.
Forstaag the Sweltering is a Nord barbarian residing on the Plaza Brindisi Dorom in Mournhold, Morrowind. He is almost completely naked; as he states, this is due to the hotness.
Foni Svel is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Ebonheart.
Floriane Tanier is a Breton residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Flicks-His-Tongue is an Argonian found in the Outlaws Refuge in the city of Windhelm. He is a prostitute who offers to sell his body for gold.
Floriele is a Bosmer drunkard residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Fluvius Macer is an Imperial brewer found in Cheydinhal. He is the husband of Vita Macer.
Fnagdesh is an Orsimer soldier of the Daggerfall Covenant found at their camp just outside Wayrest.
Foreman Blaise is a Breton member of the Red Rook Bandits overseeing the mining operation at the Crosswych Mine, Glenumbra, in .
Foreman Connor is the Nord owner and overseer of Onsi's Breath, Bangkorai, in . He and his workers were enslaved by the Seventh Legion when they attacked and took over the mine.
Foreman Gandis is a Nord and the overseer of Shor's Stone mine.
Foreman Llothan is a Dunmer Kwama miner, and overseer of the mining operation in Darkshade Caverns I.
Forinor is a member of the Vinedusk Rangers team trying to quash the remnants of the Blacksap Rebellion.
The Forlorn One is a peaceful spirit found in the temple in Selfora who is later revealed to be Tidyn Arthalen.
Forongon is a Bosmer residing in the city of Vulkwasten, Malabal Tor.
Forge-Wife Tugha is an Orsimer found in Scarp Keep in the city of Orsinium. She is King Kurog's forge-wife. She has no unique dialogue. Shes is the author of Meet the Character – Forge-Mother Alga.
Folsi Drivam is a Dunmer found inside the Temple of Ire in Orsinium. He is impossible to interact with.

Forge-Mother Alga gra-Orsinium, also known as Forge-Wife Alga gro-Bagrakh, is an Orsimer. She is the mother of King Kurog, and often serves as an adviser to him. Alga is a devout worshiper of Trinimac, and has played an important role in the rebuilding of Orsinium. She is later revealed to be the secret leader of the Vosh Rakh.
Kharza or Forge-Wife Kharza is an Orsimer Forge-Wife of the Chief Ramash, chief of the Tumnosh Clan. She can be found in the Tumnosh Clanhold near the Graystone Quarry
Florentius Florius is an Imperial residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.

The Flint-Tooth Warchief was a Goblin commander of a Flint-Tooth Tribe who fought against Frandar Hunding's forces during the Yokudan arrival on Hammerfell. His ghost is found during the trials at HoonDing's Watch, and is the second enemy leader encountered.
Folvys Inladori is a Dunmer priest found in Iliath Temple. He has no unique dialogue.
Folms Telvanni is a Dunmer noble of House Telvanni found outside the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City.
Foreman Svadstar is a Dunmer crafter residing on a wooden platform above the Foundation's Rising marketplace in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Forbrand is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Foreman Lathdar is a Nord and the foreman of the kwama egg-mine in Gnisis.

Fonas Anndrommo is a Dunmer chef residing in Ald'ruhn. She remains to witness the Ashlander rituals commemorating Skar's defeat. She is an Ashlander of the Ahemmusa Tribe. She has no unique interactions.
Foreman Nox is a Nord laborer residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell. He is the foreman of Vassir-Didanat Mine and the author of Bloody Note.
Florine is a Breton provisioner residing in the town of Bramblebreach in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood. She spends most of her time inside Serchel's Home.

Florius Larsus was a Captain of the Imperial Legion during Titus Mede I's reign. He was the superior in command of Water’s Edge garrison. He was considered to be a good friend by prince Attrebus; they knew each other since they were six years old. He was surprised to see Attrebus alive when he arrived to Water’s Edge. Attrebus convinced Florius to accompany him in his adventure to hunt Umbriel instead of sending the prince back to the Imperial City. Florius' right hand, Riente, proved to be an agent working for Hierem. Attrebus found Florius dead in his chair, with his head on the table. He had been stabbed at the base of the skull.
Flora Dorso is a Breton who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.
Florentia Candidus is an Imperial found in Elden Root, Wayrest, Mournhold, and Vulkel Guard. She can be seen talking to Zhiraz about recent dragon attacks in Elsweyr.
Flildte is a Redguard jester in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.

Flinthild Demon-Hunter was a Merethic Era hero and the second member of Khunzar-ri's kra'jun – his company of heroes – who fought against the dragons of Elsweyr along with Nurarion the Perfect, Anequina Sharp-Tongue, and Cadwell, after being convinced to leave her castle in Skyrim.
Foryn Gilnith is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Seyda Neen and makes his living as a fisherman.

Fortis is an Imperial living in Cloud Ruler Temple north of Bruma. He serves as a member of the Blades. Fortis is one of the few members to wield an Akaviri Dai-Katana. He can be most often found sparring with Pelagius outside in the temple courtyard.

Frandar do Hunding Hel Ansei No Shira, commonly known as Frandar Hunding, was a Redguard hero. He was born in 1E 720, in the region of High Desert, on the continent of Yokuda. He grew up in a period of constant turmoil, the civil war in Yokuda, and led his people from the annihilation they faced to their new home in Hammerfell. He is also famous as being the father of his son, Divad.
Foves Arenim is a Dunmer assassin and a member of House Hlaalu who can be found in Caldera.
Frald the White is a Nord warrior who can be found in Ebonheart. He is the commander of the Hawkmoth Legion.
Francois Motierre is a Breton commoner who lives in Chorrol. His house is left of Arborwatch in Chorrol and is protected with a Hard lock.
Foul Fagus is an Imperial beggar living in Skingrad. Foul Fagus is infected with Bone Break Fever and the Shakes diseases.

Fralav the Faker is an Imperial beggar in the Elven Gardens District. Fralav is infected with the disease Black-Heart Blight. Like all beggars, he is a spy for the Gray Fox. In the Speechcraft Training quest, the Hero are required to have a conversation with all beggars, including Fralav.
Francine Velain is a Breton commoner who worships the Daedric Prince Nocturnal. Francine has devoted her entire life to serving Nocturnal and can be found at the Shrine of Nocturnal.
Fralvia Sibassius is an Imperial warrior residing in the cave of Punsabanit, a bandit hideout.
Fralia Gray-Mane is an Elder Nord and the mother of Avulstein, Olfina, and Thorald, and wife of Eorlund. She operates a jewelry stall in the Whiterun marketplace.
Frabbi is a Nord citizen of Markarth. She runs the Silver-Blood Inn with her husband, Kleppr, and their two children, Hroki and Hreinn.
Francois Beaufort is an Imperial orphan living in Honorhall Orphanage.
